name: mutation-session
body: A session-scoped process that owns one worktree DB for the duration of an update session (`apg session start` … `apg session end`). It is ephemeral, not a daemon: it lives only for the session, holds the DB as single writer, applies mutation attempts in order, and flushes/rebuilds the derived projection in a batch. It is reachable only through a Unix socket under `apg/.trans/`. Because it owns the DB exclusively, no other opener can race it.
